title: Standing Firm in the Face of Spiritual Attack
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful testimony of spiritual warfare and the victory of God's life-giving power. Hear the incredible story of how Pastor Chris's life was literally threatened by a severe spiritual attack, but he refused to back down and instead chose to stand on the truth of God's Word. This sermon will inspire and equip you to stand strong in the face of adversity and experience the miraculous breakthroughs that come from living by faith.
